document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The  expedition  spends  the  day  working  through  a  baffling 
network  of  waterways.  Sometimes  you  are  forced  to  back 
down impassable channels to find an easier way; sometimes 
you blunder across the heads of powerful chutes and are swept 
along with them. At certain points, your party has to wade in 
waist-deep water, inching the craft along by hand.

You pass labyrinths of wooded islands, fast water, and drift. 
Finally, you select a peaceful backwater in which to moor and 
make camp for the night.
Roll 1D10: if the result is even, go to 4; if the result is odd, go to 5.
